{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Only completed orders
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now check for confounding: is channel independent of customer_segment?
# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(crosstab)

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_by_channel)

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Check if the difference is due to segment imbalance
# Compute conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(conversion_by_segment)

# Compute average revenue by segment
avg_revenue_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['revenue'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by customer_segment:")
print(avg_revenue_by_segment)"}
